text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Pisa-san, once again, happy birthday to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, the restaurant we reserved was 
closed due to an electrical failure, and 
the backup place was fully booked so we 
couldn't get in... I apologize for the 
trouble.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please don't apologize. I had a 
wonderful time. Buying bentos and having a 
picnic in the park!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san, you rearranged the schedule so 
diligently for me... I'm truly grateful.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
There were lovely little birds too... 
Thank you so much for taking me to such a 
wonderful park.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That's true. So many little birds flocked 
over... I was a bit surprised.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
You were probably singing "Happy Birthday" 
for me. Even now, I can clearly remember 
that beautiful singing voice. ...It was 
such a happy, gentle time.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I want to feel that way again. If 
possible, next time with you as well, 
Flash-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Please do not worry. I have already 
formulated the next plan. This time, with 
a truly flawless strategy.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My, I look forward to it. However, no 
matter what kind of plan it is—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Just knowing how much you care makes me 
happy♪
